label: S. 5254
title: Civil Nuclear Export Act of 2026

items.snippet: This bill provides the Export-Import Bank with certain authorities to finance civil nuclear energy exports.
Additionally, the bill expands the China and Transformational Exports Program (CTEP) by making civil nuclear energy eligible for financing under the program.

Currently, the bank may extend loans, guarantees, and insurance to advance the comparative leadership of the United States with respect to China in specified export areas (e.g., artificial intelligence, biotechnology, and wireless communications equipment).

R000584.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
R000584.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
R000584.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
